rule: Production x commercial-feed share x eFCR. The complement of commercial share is not necessarily unfed. Exclude farm-made/direct whole-fish inputs unless separately estimated.
consequence: Model scope; not all aquaculture feed

rule: Use source group-year global p and eFCR for all countries. Actual regional species composition comes from each input year.
consequence: Regional practice differences unresolved; no invented multipliers

rule: Select FAO564 1995 anchor; Tacon2015 annual2000-2009; Tacon2026 annual2010-2023. Retain overlapping raw vintages and projections separately.
consequence: Source-vintage changes may cause discontinuities; do not interpret all as real technological change

applies_to: 1996-1999 feed-use coefficients; gaps between marine anchors
rule: Interpolate p and eFCR separately; compute product afterward. Interpolate FM and FO separately. Fractions remain bounded.
consequence: Constructed values, not annual observations; no estimated uncertainty interval

rule: Optional hold of1995 p/eFCR/FM/FO. Default processing rejects until --early-policy hold or blank selected. No-backcast coefficient table also included.
consequence: Very low confidence; cannot claim reconstruction of early wet/direct/farm-made feeding practices

rule: FAO564 anchors1995,2000,2005,2007,2008; Naylor2017 endpoint; hold2017 in2018-2023. Explicit analog for miscellaneous diadromous group.
consequence: Not a newly observed2021 or2023 marine share

rule: Naylor reports wild-fish oil, not a separate trimming-oil column. Use that number as total-oil proxy for continuity, label unresolved omission; never claim trimming-oil is observed zero.
consequence: Total FMFO may be understated. 2009-2016 oil interpolation bridges non-identical definitions; priority for revision

rule: After assigning FMFO, distribute remainder by relative crop/animal/additive/unallocated weights of Tacon2015 Figure5. Do not apply its generic aquatic share on top of FMFO.
consequence: Synthetic recipe; strong temporal transfer assumption, especially pre2015

applies_to: Salmon, marine shrimp, tilapia; all years when selected
rule: Use Skretting2021 conditional nonmarine proportions; preserve global FMFO trajectory. Freeze conditional proportions backward and forward only as a sensitivity. Do not transfer seabass/bream to all marine fish.
consequence: Company-to-global transfer; not reported full diet, not evidence of a historical crop trend

applies_to: Earlier mixed freshwater/diadromous group; diadromous marine shares
rule: Pre2010 miscellaneous diadromous/sturgeon p/eFCR inherits mixed freshwater/diadromous proxy. Marine shares inherit miscellaneous freshwater/ODF profile. Mapping flags retained.
consequence: No independent early group observation

applies_to: FAO country162, SAL, 2020-2023 only when enabled
rule: Use Aas2022 2020 national inventory ingredient fractions; hold through2023. Keep commercial p/eFCR unchanged. No override in earlier years.
consequence: 2021-2023 carry-forward; not new inventory measurements

rule: Subtract8155t krill from174172t reported forage-meal category; put krill in OtherFeed. Normalize by reported1976709t total; tiny component-rounding residual retained in OtherFeed.
consequence: Processed ingredient allocation only; no wet-fish conversion

rule: Transfer ingredient mass fractions to modeled commercial-feed mass using one-to-one composition accounting; no explicit manufacturing moisture/loss adjustment.
consequence: Tacon moisture basis unspecified; Aas as-is and DM eFCR differ. Do not label all coefficients dry matter.

rule: FeedCrops + ReductionFish + OtherFeed = total. OtherFeed holds terrestrial animals, microingredients and unallocated/other materials.
consequence: Neither renormalize two-input totals to100 nor silently put animals in crops

applies_to: Reference shrimp profile; freshwater crustaceans using same profile
rule: Printed Tacon2015 shrimp labels total90%. Retain10 percentage points as unallocated in original template; rescale within its nonmarine remainder.
consequence: Do not silently correct source graphic or infer missing ingredient identity

rule: FAO564 estimates terrestrial animal ingredients below about1% globally near2008. Frozen modern/generic nonmarine recipes can contradict this. Flag as structural sensitivity, not calibrated history.
consequence: No single validated crop history provided. Revise with historical regional ration data before using early animal/crop totals substantively

applies_to: Unmapped codes and unsupported feed pathways
rule: Reject new codes by default; --allow-unmapped preserves unestimated quantities. Retain NONFED grow-out and OUT_OF_SCOPE as separate statuses.
consequence: Only547 supplied2021 item codes mapped; historical code additions must be reviewed

rule: Use supplied species production without replacing255 missing positive cells or normalizing feed to Tacon global total. Preserve old coverage audit.
consequence: 2021 feed quantity is a modeled covered subtotal, not exhaustive actual global feed consumption

rule: Do not use FAO2011 2010+ projections or Tacon2015 future rows as observed history. Tacon2026 2025/2030 excluded. Cottrell2025 diets are sensitivity designs.
consequence: Publication year not data year

rule: Store regional FCRs and source boundaries; do not map toGCAM32 or combine with global commercial shares without checking group/ration and feed-mass definitions.
consequence: No unwarranted regional precision

rule: Keep FM andFO separately internally. Unknown trim oil remains blank. No whole-fish wet-input requirement derived and no universal25% conversion applied.
consequence: Meal andoil are joint products; avoid double counting; ReductionFish includes modeled processed product from multiple origins

applies_to: Naylor2021 corrections and inaccessible visual renderings
rule: Two published corrections identified; their full text could not be retrieved. Main table inspected via article copy; flags retained. Some web-PDF screenshots unavailable, so tables read from parsed text and arithmetic checked.
consequence: Do not claim full correction reconciliation or visual verification for every web table
